purpose: Set tone, identity, and first impression
typical_content: Project/campaign title, client name, agency name, date, confidentiality notice
ideal_media: Full-bleed hero image or branded texture, logo
visual_layout: Centred single focal point, minimal elements, strong typography

purpose: Establish who is presenting and why
typical_content: Agency intro, team credentials, relationship to brief, session objectives
ideal_media: Team photo, agency reel thumbnail, brand marks
visual_layout: Split layout — text left / image right, or centred statement

purpose: Orient the audience to what follows
typical_content: Agenda, structure outline, what to expect, session duration
ideal_media: Icons, numbered list graphic, simple timeline visual
visual_layout: Clean list or numbered grid, generous white space
copy_density: Low — bullet points or numbered items

purpose: Recap the client's original brief or challenge statement
typical_content: Client's own words, brief excerpt, project scope, success criteria
ideal_media: Pull-quote styling, document excerpt visual
visual_layout: Large pull-quote centred, or brief doc overlay

purpose: Define the core problem the work addresses
typical_content: Problem statement, market friction, business tension, what's at stake
ideal_media: Data visualization, tension diagram, before/after
visual_layout: Bold statement centred, supporting evidence below

purpose: Bring the target audience to life
typical_content: Demographics, psychographics, behaviours, verbatim quotes, day-in-life
ideal_media: Portrait photography, persona cards, quote overlays
visual_layout: Grid of persona cards, or single portrait with overlaid data
copy_density: Medium — mix of data points and human quotes

purpose: Show the competitive and cultural landscape
typical_content: Competitor positions, market trends, cultural forces, category data
ideal_media: Charts, competitor logos, trend imagery, data viz
visual_layout: Dashboard-style multi-element layout, or clean chart focus

purpose: Reveal the core human or cultural truth
typical_content: Single powerful insight statement, supporting evidence, source
ideal_media: Minimal — typography-led, optional supporting image
visual_layout: Centred single statement, large type, dramatic white space
copy_density: Low — 1 sentence insight + 1–2 lines of support

purpose: Present the strategic framework or approach
typical_content: Strategic pillars, positioning framework, messaging hierarchy
ideal_media: Framework diagram, strategic model visualization
visual_layout: Diagram-centred, clean supporting labels

purpose: Frame the strategic opening the brand can own
typical_content: Opportunity statement, white space in market, unmet need
ideal_media: Gap diagram, opportunity map, market white space visual
visual_layout: Bold statement + supporting visual evidence
copy_density: Low-medium — opportunity framed as a single compelling statement

purpose: State the core brand or campaign proposition
typical_content: Single proposition line, supporting rationale, brand promise
ideal_media: Typography-led, optional brand visual
visual_layout: Centred large-type proposition, supporting line below

purpose: Introduce a creative direction
typical_content: Route name, concept statement, visual mood, tonal description
ideal_media: Mood board, style frames, visual territory images
visual_layout: Immersive — full-bleed mood imagery with overlaid concept text

purpose: Show the creative idea in its fullest expression
typical_content: Hero executions, campaign name, manifesto, key visual
ideal_media: Hero creative, campaign film stills, key art
visual_layout: Full-bleed hero creative, or gallery of executions

purpose: Show how the idea lives across channels
typical_content: Channel-specific executions — social, OOH, digital, print, experiential
ideal_media: Mockups, device frames, environment renders
visual_layout: Grid of execution mockups, or channel-by-channel sequence

purpose: Show where and when the work will appear
typical_content: Channel mix, media weights, targeting approach, flighting
ideal_media: Media plan chart, channel icons, Gantt-style timeline
visual_layout: Table or Gantt chart, clean and scannable

purpose: Show project phases and milestones
typical_content: Key dates, phases, deliverables, dependencies, milestones
ideal_media: Gantt chart, timeline graphic, milestone markers
visual_layout: Horizontal timeline, clear phase blocks

purpose: Explain how the work will be made
typical_content: Production approach, key partners, methodology, shoot plan
ideal_media: Production stills, partner logos, process diagram
visual_layout: Split — process visual + partner/methodology details

purpose: Present cost and investment structure
typical_content: Budget breakdown, phase costs, options, investment rationale
ideal_media: Clean table, pie chart, or tiered options visual
visual_layout: Table or tiered card layout, clean and professional

purpose: Prove capability through past work
typical_content: Challenge, solution, results, client context, visual examples
ideal_media: Campaign imagery, results graphics, client testimonial
visual_layout: Narrative sequence — mini-deck within the deck
copy_density: Medium — concise storytelling with proof points
typical_position: Varies — mid-deck for credentials, late for pitch

purpose: Add human voice or external authority
typical_content: Client quote, consumer verbatim, expert endorsement, research finding
ideal_media: Portrait photo, pull-quote typography
visual_layout: Centred large pull-quote, attribution below, optional portrait
copy_density: Low — the quote IS the content
typical_position: Variable — wherever human voice strengthens the argument

purpose: Show measurable outcomes and impact
typical_content: KPIs, before/after metrics, growth numbers, award wins
ideal_media: Data visualization, metric cards, trophy/award imagery
visual_layout: Metric dashboard or before/after comparison layout

purpose: Challenge assumptions and stimulate thinking
typical_content: Bold question, controversial statement, unexpected data point
ideal_media: Dramatic typography, stark imagery
visual_layout: Centred provocative statement, maximum visual impact
typical_position: Variable — often opening or transition moments

purpose: Facilitate group activity during a workshop
typical_content: Activity brief, instructions, time allocation, materials needed
ideal_media: Template graphic, example output, timer visual
visual_layout: Instruction-card layout — clear steps, visible timer

purpose: Create a visual pause between sections
typical_content: Section title, transition phrase, visual break
ideal_media: Abstract texture, gradient, brand pattern
visual_layout: Full-bleed colour or texture with centred section title

purpose: End with impact and clear next steps
typical_content: Thank you, contact details, next steps, final provocation, CTA
ideal_media: Brand mark, contact info, inspiring closing image
visual_layout: Centred closing statement, contact details below
copy_density: Low — memorable final statement + practical info
